final_text: The bug was twofold in `rtl/pwm.v`: `duty_q` was being latched one cycle too early (on `cnt == 0` instead of at the `255→0` wrap), and `pwm_out` used `cnt <= duty_q` instead of `cnt < duty_q`. Both are fixed now, and `TEST PASSED` confirms the design meets the spec.
